title: 7 Esker Pines, Lucan, Co. Dublin
description:
Beautiful 3-Bedroom Duplex Apartment for Rent in Lucan

We are delighted to offer this beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 3/4-bathroom duplex apartment located in a quiet and secure gated development just off the Lucan Road.

This spacious first-floor duplex has been renovated to a high standard, offering modern interiors, quality flooring throughout, secure parking and excellent access to local amenities and transport links.

Property Features:

* Spacious 3-bedroom duplex apartment
* 3/4 modern bathrooms, including an en-suite
* Bright and spacious open-plan living, kitchen and dining area
* Modern fitted kitchen with ample base and eye-level storage
* Breakfast counter
* Modern appliances
* Balcony off the dining area, providing plenty of natural light
* Quality flooring throughout
* Guest WC
* Secure designated parking
* Located within a private gated development
* Quiet and family-friendly setting

Accommodation:

Downstairs:

* Entrance hallway
* Guest WC
* Spacious living room
* Modern open-plan kitchen/dining area
* Double bedroom with ensuite bathroom
* Bathroom
* Balcony

Upstairs:

* Master double bedroom with en-suite bathroom
* Additional double bedroom
* Bathroom

 Excellent Location

The apartment is ideally located within walking distance of Lucan Village, with a wide range of shops, cafés, restaurants, schools, sports and leisure facilities nearby.

The property also offers excellent transport links, with Dublin Bus routes close by and easy access to the N4 and M50 motorway network. Liffey Valley Shopping Centre and various retail and commercial parks are also within easy reach.

A fantastic opportunity for those looking for a modern, spacious and well-connected home in Lucan.

 Please get in touch for further information or to arrange a viewing.
